_about: Layout references hand-transcribed from the K2 Base report of project A (ref-a, PDF kept out of git, anonymised). Field sizes are printed to 1 cm, distances to roof edges to 0.1 m (truncated). See crates/pv-layout/tests/k2_layout.rs.
_grid: Dm = 10 mm between modules along u (bottom rails), Dc = 20 mm along v (modules clamped on the top rails). Blocks of at most 2 x 2 modules, anchored lower-left; 0.08 m between blocks along u (printed), 0.13 m along v (derived: top rails overhang 0.05 m at each end, 0.03 m between rail ends; reproduces all printed field lengths).

rails._about: Cut lists of the 4 roofs (pieces per length) and article quantities. Bottom rails: 'long' span 2 module columns, 'short' 1 column. K2 lengthens some bottom rails beyond the base length depending on the seam positions. In roof-1 field 2, block 6 is K2's (2 x 2) - 1 block: the removed module is the top one of its right column; K2 prints a reduced bottom-rail spacing of 0.98 m for that column.

roof_1_face._about: roof-1 reconstructed from the printed dimensions: eave 26.18 m, ridge 19.62 m, hip 9.45 m (= sqrt(6.56^2 + 6.80^2)), slope height 6.80 m, right side vertical and free (K2 assigns verge zones along it). The printed block distances are horizontal distances from each block's lower-left corner to the hip, and distances to eave / ridge / right edge. Field origins (lower-left module corner) are the ones consistent with all 18 printed values.

rebuild._about: Project A rebuilt from an empty project (crates/pv-pipeline/tests/atrium_rebuild.rs). Two mirrored buildings of 26.18 x 12.86 m, ridge at 25.00 m, long sides pitched 19 deg, one end hipped (hip run 6.56 m: ridge 19.62 m), the other a gable; standing seams every 0.60 m from the eave-left corner of each face. Field origins (lower-left module corner, face frame: u along the eave from the left corner seen from outside, v up the slope) solved from every printed block distance: left / right horizontally from the block's lower corners, ridge vertically from its upper-right corner, eave from its lower edge. K2 drew the hip-right faces 26.20 m x 6.81 m (hip run 6.58 m): the origins are solved on that geometry; on the rebuilt 26.18 m faces the hip-side distances are 2 cm shorter.
